subject.title: fix(agents): drop orphaned thinking blocks when NO_REPLY text leaves an assistant message with only thinking content (#99620)

question: Should replay normalization generically discard a silence-associated assistant turn that contains only recognized thinking-family blocks, or should this protection be limited to Anthropic-family provider validation?
rationale: Both choices can prevent the reported loop, but only maintainers can authorize the cross-provider compatibility policy of deleting historical replay context in shared core normalization.

options.title: Accept the bounded generic rule
options.body: Land this narrow guard because it preserves visible text, tool calls, and unknown blocks while removing only a silent turn that cannot produce user-visible output.

options.title: Move it to provider validation
options.body: Keep shared replay unchanged and apply the orphaned-thinking rule only through Anthropic-family replay validation, accepting a larger provider-specific change.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Leave the canonical issue open until maintainers define a different replay invariant, accepting continued permanent-loop exposure for affected sessions.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded generic rule
recommendation.body: Land this narrow guard because it preserves visible text, tool calls, and unknown blocks while removing only a silent turn that cannot produce user-visible output.
